trace_rows.text: Contractor asks whether they can expense a monitor.
Company-issued equipment only; manager pre-approval required; personal devices excluded.
Company-issued equipment may be expensed with manager pre-approval.
A monitor purchase with a receipt can be treated as sufficient reimbursement documentation.
You can buy a personal monitor and expense it after purchase if you keep the receipt.
Yes. For a personal monitor, submit the receipt after purchase; the receipt is enough.
Scalar-only checks pass, but source constraints were not preserved.
